description: Department of Govt. Printing - Amendment No. 4 to the Code of Printing Service Minute
reasoning: This gazette notification contains amendments to the Printing Service Minute of the Department of Government Printing, specifically addressing public service recruitment qualifications, examination requirements, and appointment procedures for various printing-related positions. It falls under Public Service Gazettes as it deals with public sector service conditions, recruitment criteria, and qualification equivalencies (NVQ levels vs. traditional educational qualifications) for government printing department personnel.
